text:
alex: CI green on main but my PR #4821 red on macos-bazel-x86_64
alex: failing during link step: undefined reference to `__atomic_fetch_add_8`
alex: suspect after gcc image bump (gcc-12.2 -> gcc-13) in last toolchain roll
samantha: which target? can you paste the failing link invocation?
alex: //src/serving/runtime:llama_runtime
alex: here's the relevant link line from CI (truncated):
```/usr/bin/c++ ... -Wl,-O1 -o bazel-out/darwin-fastbuild/bin/src/serving/runtime/llama_runtime ... -Wl,--start-group ... -lpthread -lrt```
mike: that symbol often means libatomic not linked on some toolchains.
laura: gcc13 changed atomics for 64-bit on x86? maybe need -latomic for static builds.
alex: CI is using our bazel toolchain image: gcr.io/redwood/gcc:13.0
samantha: can you trigger a rerun with GTEST_FILTER to just that target so logs easier?
alex: done: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/47921 rerun queued
ci-bot: Build #47921 started (master, PR #4821) — job: macos-bazel-x86_64
infra-bot: quick triage checklist: 1) reproduce locally 2) try linking with -latomic 3) bisect toolchain if needed
mike: repro locally with docker image `gcr.io/redwood/gcc:13.0` and bazel build //src/serving/runtime:llama_runtime
alex: repro OK, adding -latomic to cc_library linkopts fixes it locally
samantha: we should add a conditional linkopt in the bazel toolchain or in the target's BUILD file
laura: prefer adding to the toolchain (gcc13) so other targets benefit
mike: can we add fallback in CMake for our on-prem builds too? note: BUILD files vs cmake parity
alex: opening a tiny PR to update toolchain image's toolchain-config: PR #4822
alex: leaves CI to validate. pinging infra to coordinate rollback plan if this causes other regressions
samantha: noted, assigning to @mike for a quick review
mike: will review in 30m
ci-bot: Build #47921 completed — FAILURE — link error persists on some shards
alex: attaching full link log: (see gist) https://gist.github.com/alex/abcdef
laura: looks like some shards are using static-libstdc++ variant; need libatomic in both dynamic and static cases
mike: bisect plan: roll back toolchain image to previous (gcc-12.2) in canary env vs apply linkopt; we should do canary patch first
samantha: agree. let's land PR #4822 to canary pool only, watch metrics for 1 hour, then roll to rest
alex: thanks all :thumbsup:
